topic: assistant surgery appearance reverts on outfit change

scope.kind: static source investigation plus a small assignment model

finding.confidence: high static confidence; native gameplay remains untested
finding.rootCause: $plastics_confirm_appearance replaces dynslave with the patient role but contains hard-coded slave_type = txt. Assistant appearance/avatar changes, assistant_type stays old, and slave_type is incorrectly changed.
finding.matchesReport: Slave surgery updates its own type correctly; assistant outfit buttons and imagepack rendering continue to use the old assistant_type.

references.detail: fullimage and seed avatars are target-dependent but slave_type at line 5077 is hard-coded
outfit buttons rewrite $assistant[fullimage] from role arrays indexed by assistant_type
assistant uses assistant_type; indpack outfit path wins over fallback fullimage
resolver only uses supplied actor ID and known aliases; it does not repair assistant_type or actor caches

reproductionConditions.static: Choose a new appearance txt != assistant_type while $plastics_target is assistant; then choose an available assistant outfit or render an indpack outfit keyed by assistant_type.

oldSaveNotes: No user save was read. The current macro already contains the bug; an old save is not required to create it.

$plastics_confirm_appearance is a dynamic string stored in state; a future code fix should ensure the corrected macro is refreshed for loaded saves, e.g. a narrow marker check or existing #dynamic refresh path.

A save already affected may retain inconsistent assistant_type/fullimage/avatar and incorrectly changed slave_type. If the outfit has overwritten fullimage, the intended appearance cannot be safely restored from current assistant_type alone. A selected before/after save or exact patient and chosen appearance ID would be needed before targeted repair.

seedBodyIndpack.seed: Selected avatar, gray avatar, clear avatar use $seed_ava[txt]; original assistant_type remains unrelated due to the hard-coded write.
seedBodyIndpack.body: The surgery block does not write body-image keys boobs_img or pussy_img. Their independent values are not needed to explain the outfit reset. No body-image repair is proposed.
seedBodyIndpack.indpack: display_fullimage picks indpack_*[assistant_type] for the outfit, so an old type selects the old pack. Changing image files or pack paths is not the minimal fix.

minimumProposedChange.additionalCompatibilityWork: Ensure loaded saves refresh this dynamic definition. Evaluate already-affected saves separately; do not bulk-rewrite saves.

modelVerification.kind: JavaScript assignment and image-selection model only; not native QSP execution
modelVerification.note: Assistant cases follow the assistant-stat outfit write; the slave control retains its selected default image and has the correct ID for any indexed imagepack lookup.

neededInformation: For validating the specific existing save or planning recovery: exact assistant, chosen surgery appearance, whether the switch was assistant appearance buttons or equipment clothing, and one before/after selected save if authorized. No save is needed to establish the static type-write defect.

memoryUsed.note: Use active WORK path and distinguish static checks from live game proof
